notes:
Groundwork for tracking down transfers that fail away from home.

**This release changes nothing you can see.** It records what the Wi-Fi radio was doing around each transfer between tablets, into a small file on the tablet itself.

Transfers have been reliable on some networks and unreliable on others. The likely reason is that a tablet has only one Wi-Fi radio, shared between the network it is joined to and the direct tablet-to-tablet connection — so the network you are on can constrain how the two tablets talk. This release gathers the evidence needed to confirm or rule that out.

It is written to a file rather than the system log because the system log is overwritten during normal use, which would lose a morning's problem by the afternoon.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
